raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver treats them all as local. v2 rows are therefore shifted +6h, so late-evening Chicago sales land on the next date as 00:00-06:00 timestamps (all 36 rows on 01-19). Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions fixes txn_ts, txn_date and every gold table downstream.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
